short_summary: First run of the weekly events routine. Searched markets, music, theatre, family, sport and food & drink events across the Cape Town metro. 8 events cleared the 3-source non-resale verification bar and were published (Neighbourgoods Market, Bay Harbour Market, Soul Sisters 2026, Cape Town International Kite Festival, The Legacy of Dance Gala, South African HorrorFest, Liefde By Die Dam 10, Mamma Mia! The Musical). 7 candidates discarded: V&A Waterfront Busker Festival and DSK Bazaar 2026 (conflicting/unconfirmed exact 2026 dates across sources), Cape Town Cycle Tour and OUTsurance Gun Run (turned out to be outside the Oct-Nov window or already past), Pangea festival and Bliss Family Festival (outside City of Cape Town metro, in Stellenbosch/Franschhoek), Kirstenhof Community Market (organiser site kcbn.co.za blocked, could not confirm next date from independent sources in time budget).
